# Session Information

This repository supplements the manuscript by

Dylan Goff, Thomas Dirnböck, Ika Djukic, Markus Gorfer, Barbara Kitzler, Johannes Kobler, Matthias Schlögl & Eugenio Diaz-Pinés (2026):
**Drying-Rewetting cycles reduce soil CO<sub>2</sub> and N<sub>2</sub>O emissions while increasing CH<sub>4</sub> uptake in two Austrian broadleaved forests**.

```{r}
#| include: false
library("here")
source(here::here("dev", "logging.R"))
log_script_start("sessioninfo")

lockfile <- renv::lockfile_read(here::here("renv.lock"))
package_names <- names(lockfile$Packages)

if (!length(package_names)) {
  stop("No packages found in renv.lock.")
}

session <- sessioninfo::session_info(
  pkgs = package_names,
  include_base = TRUE
)
```

## Environment

```{r}
#| echo: false
session
```

```{r}
#| include: false
logger::log_info(paste(

))
log_script_end("sessioninfo")
```
